consequences.text: Practitioners responsible for written or oral submissions containing references to non-existent cases, legislation or other material may face regulatory referral, a requirement to show cause against personal costs, or both. Parties relying on non-existent references: possible adjournment, doubt about the reliability of their submissions, and potentially an adverse costs order.

disclosure_duty.text: Parties should disclose GenAI use to the other parties and the Tribunal, for example by a statement on the front page. An expert must disclose in the report the GenAI tool used, including whether it was open-loop or closed-loop, what was uploaded to it and which portion of the report it helped prepare. A Member may request an assurance that documents have been verified.
